steps.title: Ask for the identifiers of the listed collateral
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask for the identifiers of the listed collateral
To: Borrower B0053, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0053)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - 3 loans pledged to Wells Fargo match, field for field, loans that the borrower's own public securitization (SYN-ABS-B0053) reports to investors, two months running. The SEC data has no VIN: ask for the VINs and titles to settle it [ref S1-B0053-PUBLIC_POOL_OVERLAP-1befb49d]

Please provide the VINs and title documents (or other unique identifiers) for the listed assets, and every facility or trust they have been pledged or sold to by 2026-10-11.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
